messages.author: user
messages.body: curl to /chat returns 401 invalid API key.

messages.author: agent
messages.body: The website does not ask for a key. For curl, send x-api-key matching API_KEY from .env. The chat UI sets that as a cookie when you open the page.

subject: Answers ignore a file I just added

messages.author: user
messages.body: I copied a markdown file into data/sample_docs but chat still says it is not in the files.

messages.author: agent
messages.body: Files copied onto disk are not indexed until you ingest. Run python -m scripts.bootstrap_index or POST /ingest/run. Uploads from the chat page are indexed immediately.

subject: Want citations not a generic essay

messages.author: user
messages.body: The model answered without pointing at a file.

messages.author: agent
messages.body: Answers should include [1] style markers from retrieved passages. If markers are missing, the files may not contain the fact — add a clearer doc and re-ingest. Invented markers are stripped.
